question: What is their system's absolute accuracy?

answer.free_form_answer: 59.4% on wikipedia dataset, 93.4% on peer-reviewed archive AI papers, 77.1%  on peer-reviewed archive Computation and Language papers, and 79.9% on peer-reviewed archive Machine Learning papers

title: A Joint Model for Multimodal Document Quality Assessment
